newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Postabank posts HUF 2bln Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Postabank posts HUF 2bln Q1 loss.

text.p: Hungary's Postabank, hit by a deposit withdrawal wave at the end of February, posted a loss of two billion forints in the first quarter of this year, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.

Deputy Secretary of State Agnes Balazs was quoted by the Hungarian news agency MTI-Econews as saying that the losses were caused by the stagnation of the value of assets and too high interest rates on some of the bank's products.
Postabank, Hungary's second largest commercial bank, seeks an international investor, which would raise its capital this year and assure the capital basis of asset growth.

According to earlier press information Postabank's risk provisions totalled 14.15 billion forints in 1996, but the figure would be higher by 12 billion if the government had not granted a guarantee of 12 billion forints to the bank in April.

The bank reported after-tax profit for 1996 of 5.6 million forints last month. This was sharply reduced compared with a pre-tax profit figure of 3.165 billion forints published by the bank in a preliminary report on February 14.
